Hey, we just had a team member leave the BioML pipeline project and she dumped all her knowledge into a messy text file at `HANDOVER_NOTES.txt` in the workspace. There's also a `QUEUE.md` in there that she started but it's a mess and uses inconsistent labels.

We use a specific knowledge management system for our projects (see the SKILL.md in your skills directory if it exists, or check your workspace conventions). I need you to properly onboard this project into our system: organize the handover information into the right memory stores, fix up the task queue so it uses our standard format, and make sure the workspace is set up correctly according to our conventions.

Essentially: read through the handover notes, set up the workspace knowledge structure properly, and make the task backlog usable. The end result should be that any new engineer joining the project can immediately understand what's known, what's in progress, what's blocked, and how to run things.
